Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I searched the newsgroup a bit but couldn't find an
answer to the following question that emerged on the
Italian forum.

Can a Shadow Court Satyr with an Abombwe combat
card (such as Invoking the Beast) put on him use the
Reflex effect of the card?

Card text says:

Shadow Court Satyr (Changeling)
Changeling with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When Shadow Court Satyr comes into play, you may
put a combat card from your hand on him. Once during
combat, Satyr may use the ability of that card as if that
card had been played from your hand. If the card has a
cost, he pays its cost in life to use its ability. If the card
requires a Discipline, he may only use the basic ability
of that card as a vampire with a capacity of 1. If the
ability would give him blood, give him life instead.

My intuition would say that he can't, since the "basic
ability" of a combat card should be the inferior combat
effect and not the Reflex one, since "Reflex" is actually
a *different card type*, unrelated to the combat card
the effect appears on.

But an official point of view would be welcome...

Thanks!
Ciao,
Emiliano
